findings.title: The new website name bypasses the untrusted-website restriction
findings.body: `website` is gated by `untrusted_attributes`, which hides it from anonymous viewers for TL0 users, but `website_name` is added as an ordinary attribute and is computed directly from that hidden website. As a result, anonymous viewers can still learn the website host—and, when it matches the instance domain, its full path—even though the serializer intentionally withholds the website URL. Apply the same visibility check to `website_name` or omit it whenever `website` is restricted.
